title: Core normalized schema
description: Design the standard normalized schema: sessions, messages, and typed content parts with a small fixed kind set (text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, attachment, system) plus an extensible extra/raw passthrough. Every record carries timestamps, session/project identifiers, and source provenance (file, line or row). Done when the schema is specified, versioned, and round-trips through JSON.
right_now_summary: The schema still needs implementation, validation, versioning, tests, and review of its JSON examples.
